_comment: Run 11 (art-substrate). Every frame the game slices out of LimeZu Modern Interiors (32x32). Floors/walls/trims are tile rects [tx,ty,tw,th] (split explodes a block into variants); every object is a PIXEL rect [x,y,w,h] on its sheet — LimeZu packs objects edge to edge and off the tile grid, so tile rects cut them (audit, 2026-08-23). `_single` = the Theme_Sorter_Singles file it matches (scripts/art/singles-index.mjs). Re-slice with: node scripts/art/slice-atlas.mjs
